checks.check: F1: the contract takes {persistence, name, from} and the enum is still 26
F7: a source with a live session is refused, and nothing is created
F3: the parent's record is byte-for-byte unchanged by the fork
F3b: the child is sealed under its own identity
F2: the child reproduces the cookies and storage it was copied from
F11: the policy is inherited
F4: writing in the child changes nothing in the parent
F5: writing in the parent changes nothing in the child
F6: parent and child hold their own locks at the same time
F13: an ephemeral source is refused, typed, and creates nothing
F14: neither the child's record nor the answer names the parent
F17: the child seals under its own DEK
F10: a failed fork leaves no child and does not latch the parent
F9: at the profile ceiling the fork is refused and creates nothing
F15: no value, key or cookie reaches an answer or the ledger
F16: deleting the parent leaves the child intact and readable
F8: a source locked by another host is refused, and creates nothing
F18: a persistent source forks into an ephemeral child that leaves no disk
F19: an ephemeral source is refused with its own reason, either persistence
F21: the child carries the committed record, not this host's startup state
F20: an unreadable source record is a typed refusal, and no child appears
F20b: a refused fork does not latch the parent
F12: the child's download allowance is full even when the parent's is spent

limitations: design-frozen court: it fails until profile.create accepts from
F3 and F10 are the criteria that matter: a fork that damaged the profile it copied from would pass every other one
F12 is stated but not driven; it needs a network arm against a live parent and child once the fork exists
one criterion reads the contract source and its examples rather than the binary, so it is repo-local by design
the keychain-backed store is the default mode, as the profile court runs it
no profile outside a temporary root is touched, and nothing is fetched from outside this file

ruled.lock: the fork takes the source's writer lock; any live session refuses
ruled.provenance: the child's record does not name its parent
ruled.shape: profile.create gains from; the operation enum stays at 26
